meanings.note: Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('fried').

meanings.note: Prefix 'за-' marks beginning an action, covering, or stopping by along the way (stem 'казать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to order', paired with 'заказывать'.

увидеться.gloss: to see each other, meet up

Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to see each other, meet up', paired with 'видеться'.
